candidates.title: Best Paper Award
candidates.description: For the paper "Sorting Out the Document Identifier Assignment Problem", awarded at 29th ECIR 2007 in Rome; awarded to Silvestri as a researcher at ISTI-CNR.

candidates.title: Test-of-Time Award
candidates.description: Test-of-Time recognition at ECIR 2018 (Grenoble) for the 2007 paper "Sorting Out the Document Identifier Assignment Problem".

notes: Two awards verified. The DIAG Sapienza faculty page (https://diag.uniroma1.it/users/fabrizio_silvestri) and the identical Sapienza course-catalogue bio state he 'is the holder of three best paper awards and other international awards', and this is echoed by third-party speaker bios (e.g. SERICS Summer School, Underline). The ECIR 2018 Test-of-Time Award is additionally confirmed by the ISTI-CNR HPC Lab news page (https://www.isti.cnr.it/it/ricerca/ricerca/laboratories/8/High_Performance_Computing_HPC). Only ECIR 2007 could be pinned to a specific paper/venue via an institutional URL; the other two claimed 'best paper' awards are asserted in bios but I could not identify the specific conferences/papers from institutional sources within available searches — a human reviewer should follow up (candidate venues to check: SIGIR/CIKM/WSDM/SPIRE/HPCC and IIR workshops with co-authors Perego, Lucchese, Orlando, Tolomei, Cambazoglu). No ACM/IEEE/AAAI fellowship was found. Namesakes filtered out: the Italian journalist/filmmaker 'Fabrizio Silvestri' associated with fashion/Rai media, and unrelated individuals in art (Oreste Silvestri) and other non-CS fields.
